about: Immerse yourself in your STAR WARS™ battle fantasies.
Feeling the ominous thud of an AT-AT stomping down on the frozen tundra of Hoth. Rebel forces firing blasters as Imperial speeder bikes zip through the lush forests of Endor.

Intense dogfights between squadrons of X-wings and TIE fighters filling the skies. Immerse yourself in the epic STAR WARS™ battles you’ve always dreamed of and create new heroic moments of your own in STAR WARS™ Battlefront™.
STAR WARS™ Battlefront™: X-Wing VR Mission will immerse players in one of the most dreamt about Star Wars fantasies – piloting an X-wing in the far reaches of space.
This all-new mission will be exclusive to PlayStation VR this holiday, and is free* for owners of STAR WARS™ Battlefront™.
* Requires Star Wars Battlefront for PS4™, PlayStation®VR, and PlayStation Camera (all sold separately)
